summary: Iteration 7 full-stack QA of the new HR/Employees module, RBAC Permissions Matrix, Admin Profile, and production Notifications engine on the Earn2Love admin panel (live Firebase). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_hr_notif.py (auth, employees CRUD + payslips/attendance/documents append, /me/profile, GET+PUT /role-permissions with persistence + revert, notifications meta+list+audience-preview+send+404/400 guards). Frontend (demo.admin@earn2love.com / Earn2Love@Demo2026 super_admin): sidebar 'Administration' group correctly renders nav-employees, nav-permissions, nav-roles (was scrolled below fold at 1080h but data-testids present). Avatar dropdown -> my-profile-btn navigates to /profile which shows 'You don't have an HR record yet' Create form (correct empty state). Employees page: Add Employee modal opens, employee 'QAUI TestUI' created (auto code testui01) and appears as card with role/status, and delete via modal shows confirm dialog then 'Employee removed' toast (list updates). Permissions Matrix: all 5 role tabs render; super_admin tab shows locked/full-access banner; moderator switches toggle, 'Save changes' shows success toast and change persists (verified via backend PUT+GET). Notifications: campaigns list renders; Compose dialog exposes notif-title/message/type/notif-channel-in_app/push/email/notif-audience with live 8 users - 0 push - 0 email preview; Email channel is shown as inactive with amber 'Email is inactive - add a Resend API key to enable delivery' note; Send now created 'TEST_QA_ui_campaign' with status Sent and delivery '8 recipients · 8 in-app'. RBAC: super_admin performed writes (create employee, send notification, update role-permissions) without any 403. No console errors during flows.

ui_bugs.issue: After confirming delete, the parent edit modal remains open showing stale (now-deleted) employee data; user must manually close it. Toast 'Employee removed' and list update work correctly, so this is cosmetic.

issues: Switches for super_admin appear greyed but do not carry the HTML disabled/aria-disabled attribute on the switch role element (only visually locked). Consider adding aria-disabled=true for accessibility.
With 7 groups + 26 items the Administration group falls below the 1080px fold and requires scrolling; consider condensing or collapsible groups.

action_items: (cosmetic) Auto-close employee edit modal after successful delete on Employees page.
(a11y) Add aria-disabled=true / disabled prop to super_admin permission switches for screen-reader/testability parity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 709 lines - approaching the 700 line split threshold; consider splitting HR/notifications routers into modules/*.py APIRouters.

PUT /api/role-permissions accepts arbitrary body['matrix'] without Pydantic validation - a malformed payload would blindly overwrite appConfig/rolePermissions. Recommend a strict Pydantic model for the matrix shape.

In Sidebar there is no permission-based filtering: a non-super_admin will still see Administration links (Employees, Permissions Matrix). Backend enforces write-perms, but nav visibility should respect hr.editable_modules(role) so agents don't see admin-only links.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-cleanup (create+delete employee, revert permissions toggle). UI test created 'QAUI TestUI' employee, then deleted it via the modal delete flow. Notifications: 2 residual test campaigns remain in adminCampaigns (TEST_QA_iter7_notif from backend send test and TEST_QA_ui_campaign from UI send test) - safe to leave as they only wrote in-app notifications for the 8 test users; can be trimmed manually if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter7 features are healthy. To rerun: `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL ../frontend/.env|cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest tests/test_iter7_hr_notif.py -v -n0`. The Firestore employeeCode format is <first4-of-lowercase-lastname>NN (e.g. lastName='Iter7' -> 'iter01' when the prefix hasn't been used; if reused it increments). Employees delete UI: modal has a Delete button (bottom-left) that opens a confirm 'Remove employee?' dialog with a second red Delete. Notifications: RESEND_API_KEY not set - email channel intentionally disabled with amber note. Push tokens are 0 in live data - '0 push' preview is expected.
